newsitem.title: EU: REUTER EC REPORT LONG-TERM DIARY FOR DEC 31-DEC 31, 1997.
newsitem.headline: REUTER EC REPORT LONG-TERM DIARY FOR DEC 31-DEC 31, 1997.

text.p: HIGHLIGHTS
December 31, 1996 - Irish EU presidency ends. The Netherlands takes over to June 30, 1997.
THE NETHERLANDS - EARLY 1997 - The Dutch EU presidency hosts conference aimed at defining the future of the Union's relations with African, Caribbean and Pacific group of developing countries (ACP).
AMSTERDAM - Dutch presidency hosts European Council of heads of state and government (June 16-17).
MADRID - NATO holds summit to set the course for enlargement (July 8 and 9).
LUXEMBOURG - Luxembourg presidency hosts European Council of heads of state and government (December 12-13).
TUESDAY, DECEMBER 31
- Irish EU presidency ends. The Netherlands takes over to June 30, 1997.

THE NETHERLANDS - EARLY 1997 - The Dutch EU presidency hosts conference aimed at defining the future of the Union's relations with the African, Caribbean and Pacific group of developing countries (ACP). The meeting will bring together EU member states, non-governmental organisations working in development and official representatives from ACP states.
